title: Sempre
description: A 100+ year old Portuguese heritage villa in Aldona, lovingly curated by Pink Papaya Stays. Sempre is where history meets barefoot luxury in the quietest corner of North Goa.
aboutContent: Built in 1828, Sempre is a living testament to Goa's Portuguese legacy. Nestled in the slow-paced village of Aldona, this four-bedroom heritage home has been thoughtfully restored by Pink Papaya Stays to honour its past while welcoming modern comfort. Sun-dappled verandahs, hand-painted walls, heritage art, and a private pool create a setting unlike any other in Goa. The villa unfolds across two floors with two pool-facing bedrooms on the ground floor and two more private suites upstairs, each with ensuite bathrooms and balcony access. A reading library, open courtyard, and lush garden round off a space made for creative souls, families, and anyone seeking a true Goa slow-living experience. No TVs, by design. Just Goa, in its most authentic form.

faqs.question: Is this an entire villa booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, Sempre is booked as a complete private villa for up to 12 guests across 4 bedrooms.

faqs.question: Is the property suitable for families with children?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The garden, pool, and spacious common areas make Sempre ideal for multi-generation family stays.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum stay?
faqs.answer: We recommend a minimum of 2–3 nights to truly soak in the heritage atmosphere and the Aldona village pace.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to Pink Papaya Stays directly to discuss pet policies for this property.

title: Juno
description: Infinity pool, open field views, and two beautifully styled bedrooms near Candolim Juno by Pink Papaya Stays is the apartment that makes Goa look like a painting.
aboutContent: Juno is named after the film, and much like its namesake, it has a charm that is a little unexpected, full of personality, and impossible not to remember. This 2BHK by Pink Papaya Stays near Candolim is built around two defining features: an infinity pool that seems to merge with the horizon, and expansive paddy field views that make the Goa landscape feel alive and endlessly beautiful. The two bedrooms are styled with a serene confidence, while the common areas flow naturally towards the outdoor spaces where the real magic happens. With Candolim, Museum of Goa, Baga, and Fort Aguada all easily accessible, Juno strikes the perfect balance between beauty and convenience. The stay also includes 100% power backup, so your escape stays comfortable through and through.

faqs.answer: The infinity pool is within the building complex and shared among residents, though typically very quiet.

faqs.question: Are the field views unobstructed?

aboutContent: Jigsaw is precisely what its name suggests: a property where every piece comes together just right. A great choice for creative travellers, first-timers, and anyone who simply wants a Goa apartment that looks as good as it feels.

faqs.question: What is the vibe of Jigsaw?

description: Step through The Blue Door into a penthouse with panoramic views near Candolim Pink Papaya Stays' signature 2BHK for those who want North Goa's scenery on full display.
aboutContent: The Blue Door is an entrance and a promise. aboutContent: Le Bohemian is Goa's spirit in apartment form. aboutContent: Casa Viva is where Goa's natural abundance becomes your daily backdrop. aboutContent: The Sage Door is Pink Papaya Stays' most visual property in Calangute, a 1BHK styled with a calm, green-forward aesthetic that is as much about how it looks as how it feels. Sage greens, warm woods, and thoughtful plant placements create an environment that feels simultaneously serene and stylish. The pool and views complete a package that makes this apartment one of the most frequently shared on social media by guests. Calangute is the beating heart of North Goa vibrant, accessible, and brilliantly located for beach lovers and Vista Verde 002 gives you a calm retreat within it.

title: Casa Siesta
description: Near Calangute Beach, styled for rest Casa Siesta by Pink Papaya Stays is the Goa apartment designed around the art of the afternoon siesta and the beauty of slow days.
aboutContent: Every great Goa holiday has at least one great siesta and Casa Siesta by Pink Papaya Stays is built around that truth. This 1-bedroom Calangute apartment near the beach is styled in warm, sleep-inducing tones that make it very easy to drift into an afternoon nap and very difficult to leave. Pool access, a proximity to Calangute Beach, and the laid-back energy of the neighbourhood complete the picture. For those who want to embrace the full slow-travel Goa philosophy beach in the morning, siesta at noon, sunset at the shack Casa Siesta is the ideal base.

faqs.answer: While Calangute is busy, Casa Siesta is situated away from the main commercial strip in a relatively quiet residential pocket.

aboutContent: Belo Nido 'beautiful nest' in Portuguese is Pink Papaya Stays' cosy offering in Calangute. aboutContent: Named in the spirit of Goa itself, unhurried, easygoing, and happily on its own schedule Lazy Turtle by Pink Papaya Stays is for the traveller who wants to be close to the beach without the luxury price tag. faqs.question: Is Benaulim safe for families with young children?
